description: This file defines the NodesPool class responsible for initializing and managing nodes and credentials in the Flowise server. It includes methods for loading node modules, processing icons, and managing credentials, with environment-based filtering.

classes.name: NodesPool
classes.description: Class responsible for managing nodes and credentials, including initialization, loading node modules, and handling icons and credentials.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes nodes and credentials by calling respective methods.

methods.name: initializeNodes
methods.description: Loads node modules, processes icons, and filters nodes based on environment and configuration.

methods.name: initializeCredentials
methods.description: Loads credential modules and initializes credential instances.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all files from a directory.
